main.description: A guess at a clue's answer. No correctness field: verdicts are computed by the AppView at render time against the puzzle's answer key, so an answer-key correction can retroactively reclassify old attempts. No author field: authorship is structural, carried by which contributor's sub-repo within the team's space wrote the record.

clueId.description: The opaque id of the clue, within the referenced session's puzzle, this attempt is answering.
